title: Clearer deletion terms and DPA version 2.5
summary: The Trust Center, security overview, privacy policy, terms and DPA now describe deletion the same way: your data is kept for as long as the workspace exists, deleting the workspace in Settings removes it from the live database immediately, and copies in the database provider's daily backups expire after 7 days. Revoking the app in Entra ID stops access but deletes nothing. Disconnecting a single connector now also deletes the findings raised from it. The DPA is now version 2.5 with this wording, and an earlier acceptance carries over. The Danger zone button now reads Delete workspace, and the sub-processor badges show EU, Global or Customer region based on where each provider actually processes data.
